actions.reason: C0001 shows a coherent proliferative identity (E2F/G2M upregulation with CDKN2A/PTEN copy loss), moderate cross-modal reproducibility (ARI 0.67) with positive RNA/WXS/CNV support, and no technical confounder aligned with the defining molecular modality. Retained for downstream validation.

C0002 has a coherent PBRM1-mutant, angiogenesis-high identity with strong WXS/CNV/RNA cross-modal support (ARI 0.54). CT/site imbalance is present but does not explain the WXS/RNA-defined signal. Retained for downstream validation.

C0003 shows a strong BAP1-mutant, interferon/inflammatory identity (BAP1 OR 96.7, q=7e-8) with moderate cross-modal reproducibility (ARI 0.60) and no technical confounding. Retained for downstream validation.

C0004 lacks any significant biological enrichment across RNA, WXS, and CNV, and its cross-modal membership support is weak (median support 1, one patient with no positive modality). No coherent identity is defensible and no structural revision is indicated.

C0005 has a coherent non-3p-loss, VHL-wildtype-like identity supported by a distinctive CNV profile (3p/VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 loss depletion) with hypoxia-low/immune-low RNA trend. Structure is weak (ARI 0.51) but no positive evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained with uncertainty for downstream validation.

C0006 shows a coherent metabolic identity (fatty acid/peroxisome/adipogenesis upregulation) with VHL depletion and chr8 loss enrichment. Cross-modal reproducibility is low (ARI 0.46) but no positive structural evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained with uncertainty for downstream validation.
